product_metadata.title: DaDa Bedding Cotton Patchwork Quilt - Fairy Forest Glade Floral Print Bedspread Set, Turquoise Real Patchwork, Full, 3-Pieces
features: Fabric: 100% Cotton - Filling: 50% Cotton and 50% Polyester
Includes: One Quilt- 86 x 90" and Two Pillowcases- 20 x 26"
Machine Wash Cold, Do not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, Remove Promptly.
Thin and lightweight Quilt Perfect for Autumn, Spring & Summer Seasons
description: Get lost in the mystical Reversible Real Patchwork Fairy Forest Glade by DaDa Bedding, accented with a multi-colored floral patchwork design. This set comes with one quilt coverlet and two pillowcases. Bright and vibrantly beautiful this set will add a touch of excitement to any room. This DaDa Bedding Quilt set is available in the sizes of California King, King, Queen and Single. California King size has 3 pieces, including the quilt which is 108 x 100 inches, and 2 pillow cases which are 20 x 36. King size has 3 pieces, including the quilt which is 108 x 100 inches, and 2 pillow cases which are 20 x 36. Queen size has 3 pieces, including the quilt which is 96 x 96 inches and 2 pillow cases which are 20 x 30. Full size has 3 pieces, including the quilt which is 86 x 90 inches, and 2 pillow cases which are 20 x 26. Single size has 2 pieces, including the quilt which is 70 x 90 inches, and 1 pillow case which is 20 x 26. Care instructions: Machine Wash Cold, Iron, Wash Dark Colors Separately, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, and Remove Promptly. Fabric Material: Cotton, Filling: 50% Cotton, 50% Polyester. Imported.
